name: Conviction
body:
School abjuration; Level antipaladin 1, cleric/oracle 1, inquisitor 1, paladin 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a bit of parchment with holy text written upon it)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You utter a prayer and bolster the mental, physical and spiritual strength of the target. They gain a +2 morale bonus on saving throws. The bonus increases by +1 for every 6 caster levels you possess, to a maximum of +5 at 18th level.
